Single Page Portfolio is a free, one page personal site template built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It covers hero, projects, about, work experience, education, and contact in a single scroll, with Framer Motion transitions between sections. All content lives in two config files, so making it yours is a matter of editing arrays and swapping images. Download it, push it to Vercel, and you have a portfolio online in minutes.
